ln-bloodborn.environment: The sunless fortress-city and its under-halls
ln-bloodborn.culture: Bloodborn are the newly-turned, vampires still learning the Dusk Accord and the hungers it governs. They serve a house through their first decades, and a Bloodborn's Turning-Vigil determines whether they master the thirst or are mastered by it.
ln-bloodborn.tradition: The Turning-Vigil, the first night of the returned, spent under a house's protection and judgment.
ln-bloodborn.appearance: Pale, sharp-toothed, still adjusting to the eyes and hungers, plain house-livery.
ln-bloodborn.naming: Given name plus a house (Cael of House Mourne).
hooks: You do not yet know which house or sire made you
Your thirst is slipping the Accord's leash
A house means to use your newness against your own sire

ln-nightborn.homeland: The house-courts of the Night Court
ln-nightborn.culture: Nightborn are house-scions born into vampire nobility, raised in the Dusk Accord and the centuries-long games of the Night Court. Patient and political, they treat a debt as a leash and an alliance as a slow-tightening knot.
ln-nightborn.tradition: The Century-Court, when houses gather once a hundred years to settle debts and reweave alliances.
ln-nightborn.appearance: Aristocratic, timeless finery, house-signet, composed pallor.
ln-nightborn.naming: Given name and full house-lineage (Isadore of House Valmont, Third of the Line).
hooks: A blood-accord your house swore is now yours to honor across ages
The Century-Court falls in your generation and the debts are dangerous
Your house needs a living envoy no one will miss

ln-crimson.homeland: The warrior-halls of the crimson lines
ln-crimson.culture: Crimson are the warrior-vampire lines, house-guards and duelists who held the border through the Blood Wars. Where the Nightborn scheme, the Crimson enforce, and their disciplined night-guard are the sword behind the Accord.
ln-crimson.tradition: The Blood-Duel, a formal contest that settles house-disputes without open war.
ln-crimson.naming: Given name and a battle-honor (Rurik Redguard).
hooks: A blood-duel you must fight is rigged against your house
The Unlit are massing at the border you guard
You are ordered to enforce an Accord-ruling you find unjust

ln-moonblood.homeland: The Vale-courts where night meets moonlight
ln-moonblood.environment: Moonlit dusk and the Vale's silvered halls
ln-moonblood.culture: Moonblood are the mystic vampire lines of the Moonlit Vale, seers and dream-walkers who read the lunar tides and traffic in omens rather than blood-politics. They bridge the night-courts and the moon-courts, and their prophecies are sought and feared alike.
ln-moonblood.tradition: The Moon-Communion, a rite of reading fate in the lunar tides and the blood at once.
ln-moonblood.naming: Given name and a lunar epithet (Selara Moonveil).
hooks: A moon-communion showed a fate you would die to prevent
Your prophecy has made you a piece in a Moon Court game
The lunar tides are turning wrong and your omens with them

ln-ancient-v.homeland: The deep sunless vaults of the oldest houses
ln-ancient-v.environment: Ancient sealed crypts and lightless deep places
ln-ancient-v.culture: The Ancient are the eldest vampires, who remember the sky breaking and have seen too many ages to bother with cruelty for its own sake. They sleep for centuries in sealed vaults, and when one stirs, whole houses hold their breath, for an Ancient's waking reshapes the Accord.
ln-ancient-v.tradition: The Long Sleep, a slumber of centuries from which an Ancient wakes only for a turning of the age.
ln-ancient-v.appearance: Timeless, still, robed in dead centuries' fashion, eyes like old wells.
ln-ancient-v.naming: A single archaic name (Vhaeloth, called the Patient).
allies: Abyssal seaborn (as neighbors of the deep)
rivals: Those who would wake them for gain
ln-ancient-v.landmark: The Drowned Spire rising from the trench
hooks: An Ancient of your house is waking and no one knows what it wants
You serve an Ancient who remembers the sky breaking
Someone means to wake an Ancient to end the Accord

ln-duskborn-v.homeland: The shadow-border refuges of the returned
ln-duskborn-v.culture: Duskborn are the border-dwelling vampires who chose the edge of the light over the deep courts, wardens who hold the shadow-border against the Unlit and shelter refugees the courts ignore. Less bound by house politics, they are the closest thing to heroes the returned produce.
ln-duskborn-v.tradition: The Dusk-Watch, a self-imposed vigil holding the border where the living and the dark both press.
ln-duskborn-v.appearance: Weathered, plain border-wear, dusk-marked, watchful pallor.
ln-duskborn-v.naming: Given name and a border-post (Alden of the Grey Watch).
hooks: The border-light is failing and your watch is the last one holding
Refugees are fleeing the dark into your care
The Unlit have found something that can dim a sun

ln-tideborn-s.homeland: The reef-shallows and tide-towns of the Sapphire Sea
ln-tideborn-s.environment: Warm shallows, tide-flats, and coastal currents
ln-tideborn-s.culture: Tideborn seaborn are the shallow-water folk who trade and live along the tide-line, the most surface-facing of the sea-peoples. They keep the Tide Covenant's law and sing the tide-tables, and their harbors are where the deep meets the dry.
ln-tideborn-s.tradition: The First Descent, a young Tideborn's first dive into deeper water to earn adult standing.
ln-tideborn-s.naming: Given name plus a tide (Nael of the Turning Tide).
hooks: A covenant toll-dispute has put you between the deep and the surface
The tides are singing wrong and the elders fear the abyss
Reef-serpents are fleeing the deep and driving ashore

ln-reefborn.environment: Coral-reef cities and bright shallow gardens
ln-reefborn.culture: Reefborn seaborn are the coral-city builders, artisans who grow their homes from living reef and tend the Coral Throne. Bright and communal, they are the gardeners and craftfolk of the sea, and a reef-war over territory is their gravest fear.
ln-reefborn.tradition: The Coral-Tending, a lifelong care of a living reef-home passed down and grown across generations.
ln-reefborn.naming: Given name plus a reef (Cora of the Bright Reef).
ln-reefborn.landmark: The living Coral Throne of the covenant
hooks: Your reef-home is sickening in a strange new shape
A reef-war looms over disputed coral-territory
The Coral Throne is growing wrong and no one knows why

ln-deepborn.homeland: The cold deep-water halls below the reefs
ln-deepborn.environment: The cold lightless mid-deep, below sun and above the abyss
ln-deepborn.culture: Deepborn seaborn dwell in the cold dark below the reefs, bio-luminous folk who keep to themselves and distrust the bright surface. Patient and alien to the tide-towns, they are the bridge, and the buffer, between the reef-cities and the true abyss.
ln-deepborn.tradition: The Deepening, a rite of descending into the cold dark alone and returning bearing its light.
ln-deepborn.appearance: Dark-scaled, bio-luminous markings, blind-pale eyes, deep-glow ornaments.
ln-deepborn.naming: Given name plus a depth (Vorel of the Cold Deep).
ln-deepborn.landmark: The Silent Deep where even light dies
hooks: Something the size of an island is moving up from the abyss
You carry a light the abyss-folk want back
The Deepening showed you the trench is not empty

ln-stormtide.homeland: The storm-coast currents of the Stormreach
ln-stormtide.environment: The tempest-lashed sea where storm meets tide
ln-stormtide.culture: Stormtide seaborn ride the storm-driven currents where the Stormreach meets the sea, the wildest and boldest of the tide-folk. Kin in spirit to the Gale Riders and Stormborn, they surf the tempest-swells and salvage what the storms drown.
ln-stormtide.tradition: The Storm-Swim, riding a tempest-driven current to prove one belongs to the storm-tide.
ln-stormtide.appearance: Storm-grey scales, static-marked fins, storm-glass and salvage-charms.
ln-stormtide.naming: Given name plus a storm-current (Rael of the Tempest Race).
ln-stormtide.landmark: The drowning coasts of the Stormfall
hooks: A storm-swim carried you to a wreck no one else can reach
The tempest that shelters your current has begun to fail
You salvaged something the storm was hiding

ln-abyssborn.homeland: The vent-lit courts of the Abyssal Trench
ln-abyssborn.environment: The crushing lightless deep around black-fire vents
ln-abyssborn.culture: Abyssborn seaborn keep the alien hymn-singing courts of the trench, folk of the black fire whose faiths the surface finds disturbing. Not evil, but utterly other, they guard what sleeps near the vents and sing in registers the surface cannot hear.
ln-abyssborn.tradition: The Deep-Song, a hymn learned in the crushing dark that binds the abyss-folk together.
ln-abyssborn.appearance: Black-scaled, anglerlight lures, abyss-glass ornaments, void-pale eyes.
ln-abyssborn.naming: A resonant deep-name plus a vent (Xoloth of the Black Fire).
ln-abyssborn.landmark: The Black Fire vents of the trench
hooks: Your Deep-Song is being heard in surface harbors
The Drowned Spire has lit up for the first time in an age
You carry a drowned relic the abyss wants returned to the dark

ln-pearlborn.homeland: The pearl-current trade-routes of the Sapphire Sea
ln-pearlborn.culture: Pearlborn seaborn are the merchant-divers of the pearl-currents, the wealthiest and most cosmopolitan of the sea-folk, who run the Pearl Guild and seal treaties in gifted pearls. Diplomatic and shrewd, they are the sea's bankers and go-betweens.
ln-pearlborn.tradition: Pearl-gifting, sealing bonds and treaties with a pearl whose flaw and luster record the terms.
ln-pearlborn.appearance: Pearl-sheened scales, opulent shell-and-pearl finery, trade-marks.
ln-pearlborn.naming: Given name plus a current (Lys of the Pearl Run).
hooks: A pearl-sealed treaty you carry could stop or start a reef-war
Poachers are raiding your family's pearl-beds
A gifted pearl's hidden flaw reveals a broken bargain

ln-shellguard.homeland: The island fortress-holds of the Sapphire Sea
ln-shellguard.environment: Storm-proof island holds and reef-guarded shores
ln-shellguard.culture: Shellguards are the island-guardian turtlekin, the immovable defenders whose shield-lines never break and who hold the storm-proof island holds. Patient and lawful, they guard the elder-circles and the tide-law the sea-peoples live by.
ln-shellguard.tradition: The Shell-Marking, a life-record carved slowly into one's own shell over decades of deeds.
ln-shellguard.naming: Given name plus an island-hold (Tobar of the Green Hold).
ln-shellguard.landmark: The island holds of the Sapphire Sea
hooks: Your island hold sits above something the Deep Conclave wants sealed
A reef-war is coming to the hold you guard
The elder-circle entrusted you with a tide-law treaty to deliver

ln-seaturtle.homeland: The open-water migrations of the Sapphire Sea
ln-seaturtle.environment: The open ocean and its long migration-currents
ln-seaturtle.culture: Seaturtles are the ocean-wandering turtlekin, long-lived navigators who follow the great currents and know the whole sea as a single road. They are the pilots and living charts of the Sapphire Sea, and their memory spans generations of tides.
ln-seaturtle.tradition: The Great Migration, a life-defining circuit of the sea's currents, undertaken once to earn elder-standing.
ln-seaturtle.naming: Given name plus a current (Kaimana of the Long Current).
ln-seaturtle.landmark: The great migration-currents of the sea
hooks: A current you have followed for decades has shifted
Your living chart is the only map to a lost island
The migration crossed the path of something rising from the deep

ln-riverback.homeland: The inland waterways and river-moots of the Crownlands
ln-riverback.environment: Slow rivers, lakes, and inland waterways
ln-riverback.culture: Riverbacks are the inland-waterway turtlekin, ferry-keepers and river-moot arbiters who mediate the disputes of the barge-folk and border-towns. Trusted neutral parties, they keep the river-law and remember every treaty made on the water.
ln-riverback.tradition: The River-Moot, a slow gathering where disputes are heard across many days on the water.
ln-riverback.naming: Given name plus a river (Marn of the Slow River).
hooks: A river-moot dispute is about to turn to blood
Your ferry-route crosses over the Drowned Palace and something stirs
A treaty you keep is being denied by both parties

ln-terrapin.homeland: The marsh-villages at the Wilds' waterways
ln-terrapin.culture: Terrapins are the marsh-village turtlekin, small and communal, herbalists and quiet keepers of the fen-lore. They live in stilt-villages among the reeds and are famed for patience, healing, and the ability to outwait any trouble.
ln-terrapin.tradition: The Fen-Keeping, a rite of tending a stretch of marsh and its lore for the village.
ln-terrapin.appearance: Small mottled shells, reed-woven wraps, herb-pouches.
ln-terrapin.naming: Given name plus a marsh (Pell of the Quiet Fen).
ln-terrapin.landmark: The reed-country of the Emerald Wilds
hooks: A blight is spreading through your marsh
Your fen-lore holds a cure someone needs desperately
Something old has stirred in the reeds you tend

ln-ancientshell.homeland: The oldest island-sanctuaries of the Sapphire Sea
ln-ancientshell.culture: Ancient Shells are the eldest turtlekin bloodline, living records older than most kingdoms who remember the First Age and speak of it perhaps once a century. Their shell-markings are histories in themselves, and they are the final arbiters when all other law fails.
ln-ancientshell.tradition: The Century-Speaking, when an Ancient Shell shares one long-held memory of the First Age.
ln-ancientshell.appearance: Vast, moss-and-barnacle shells, marked with centuries of history, still eyes.
ln-ancientshell.naming: A single archaic name plus a sanctuary (Old Maru of the First Isle).
rivals: Those who would rush or exploit them
hooks: An Ancient Shell is about to speak a memory of the First Age and factions vie to hear it
The sanctuary you tend holds a First Age secret
You must protect an elder whose memory is the key to a crisis

ln-redtail.culture: Redtails are the court-and-market kitsune, brokers of favors and secrets who run the salons of the Vale. Charming and dangerous, they track favor-debts with absolute precision, and a Redtail's freely-given favor is a bond stronger than any chain.
ln-redtail.tradition: The First Mask, a coming-of-age when a young Redtail takes or is given their court-face.
ln-redtail.naming: Given name plus a court-mask (Akari of the Crimson Mask).
ln-redtail.landmark: Duskhollow, the market-town in eternal dusk
hooks: You owe a favor-debt you cannot repay and cannot escape
A favor you granted has made you a piece in a Moon Court game
You took a court-mask its former owner wants back

ln-silvertail.homeland: The old noble houses of the Moon Court
ln-silvertail.culture: Silvertails are the old noble kitsune lines, houses older than the Sundering they quietly survived, keepers of the deepest secrets and the longest games. Elegant and patient, they rule the Moon Court by knowing more than anyone and saying less.
ln-silvertail.tradition: The Tail-Reckoning, marking the addition of a new tail, a rite earned by an age of cunning survived.
ln-silvertail.appearance: Silver-furred, many-tailed with age, exquisite masks, ancestral finery.
ln-silvertail.naming: House-name and personal name (Yuki of House Silvermoon).
ln-silvertail.landmark: The Moon Court of the Vale
hooks: Your house holds a secret from before the Sundering
A tale is circulating that could topple your house
The Nine-Tailed One has called in a favor your house owes

ln-shadowtail.homeland: The shadow-border enclaves near the Vale
ln-shadowtail.environment: The twilight border where Vale bleeds into Shadowlands
ln-shadowtail.culture: Shadowtails are the border kitsune who walk where the Vale meets the Shadowlands, spies and shadow-walkers who trade secrets between the living and the returned. The most dangerous of the kitsune, they keep faiths and favors in the dark that even other kitsune fear.
ln-shadowtail.tradition: The Shadow-Mask, a court-face worn only in the dark, whose secrets are never spoken by daylight.
ln-shadowtail.appearance: Shadow-dark fur, void-touched masks, shadow-silk, dusk-gold eyes.
ln-shadowtail.naming: Given name plus a shadow-mask (Kage of the Dusk Mask).
hooks: A secret you brokered between the living and the dead has surfaced
The Unlit tried to recruit you and now want you silenced
Your shadow-mask hides a favor that could damn you

ln-frosttail.homeland: The cold high-Vale courts near the frost-line
ln-frosttail.environment: The frost-touched heights of the Moonlit Vale
ln-frosttail.culture: Frosttails are the cold-court kitsune of the Vale's high frost-line, reserved and precise, keepers of the sharpest bargains and the coolest heads. Their favors come with exacting terms, and their winter-court intrigues are famously merciless and clean.
ln-frosttail.tradition: The Frost-Bargain, a favor sealed in ice-clear terms that neither party may misread.
ln-frosttail.appearance: Frost-white fur, ice-marked masks, frost-silk finery, cold-eyed.
ln-frosttail.naming: Given name plus a frost-court (Yuki-onna of the Pale Court).
ln-frosttail.landmark: The frost-line courts of the high Vale
hooks: A frost-bargain you sealed is being twisted against you
A rival warm-court is undermining your winter-court
Your exacting terms trapped the wrong person

ln-suntail.homeland: The rare bright-day courts of the desert oases
ln-suntail.environment: The sunlit oasis-courts of the Sunscorch
ln-suntail.culture: Suntails are the rare sunlit kitsune who left the Vale's dusk for the desert's bright courts, storytellers and open-faced charmers who trade in reputation rather than shadow. Warmer than their Vale kin, they are the beloved tale-tellers and mediators of the sun-courts.
ln-suntail.tradition: The Open-Mask, a court-face worn in daylight that hides nothing, a rite of chosen honesty.
ln-suntail.appearance: Golden fur, bright open masks, sun-silk finery, story-tokens.
ln-suntail.naming: Given name plus a sun-court (Hana of the Golden Court).
hooks: A story you told has taken on a dangerous life of its own
A shadow-kitsune is spreading a lie under your open-mask
Your reputation is currency and someone is counterfeiting it

ln-voidtail.homeland: The deepest shadow-enclaves of the Shadowlands
ln-voidtail.environment: The lightless heart of the Shadowlands
ln-voidtail.culture: Voidtails are the whispered kitsune line touched by the true dark, rare and unsettling, who trade in the void's secrets and the faiths the Unlit twist. Not necessarily evil, but always dangerous, they walk closest to the deepest shadow and pay a price for it.
ln-voidtail.tradition: The Void-Mask, a rite few speak of, said to let the wearer hear the dark itself.
ln-voidtail.appearance: Void-black fur, star-absent masks, shadow-silk, eyes like held dark.
ln-voidtail.naming: A whispered name plus a void-mask (Kuro of the Hollow Mask).
ln-voidtail.landmark: The Grey Market where living and returned trade
hooks: Your void-mask let you hear something the Unlit are planning
You are suspected of being an Unlit agent and must prove otherwise
The dark whispered a secret you cannot un-know
